Definition: from G2163; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good report.
BiblicalUsage: The word euphēmía carries the sense of good report. In 2 Corinthians 6:8, the text says "by evil report and good report."
TheologicalSignificance: I read euphēmía plainly — it means good report, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
